figure_description: Two congruent horizontal rectangles labeled P and Q. Rectangle P is positioned above and to the left of rectangle Q. The bottom-right vertex of rectangle P coincides with the top-left vertex of rectangle Q. The sides of both rectangles are aligned horizontally and vertically.
